no_go_claim_category_definitions.generic_validation: Claims about generic solar / generic wind validation.

qa_items.question: What is Finco1?
qa_items.answer_snippet: Finco1 is an internal project-finance screening tool that runs the project through a full waterfall schedule — revenue, opex, CFADS, debt service, distributions, returns.
qa_items.escalation_trigger: if audience asks follow-up about whether this is a customer-facing product (defer to B11 commercial messaging guardrail)
qa_items.source_of_truth: B1 no-go list, B11 §1, B19 §1

qa_items.question: What reference projects exist?
qa_items.answer_snippet: TUHO Wind 1 and Oborovo Solar PV are reference projects with outputs pinned for regression protection.
qa_items.escalation_trigger: if audience asks if the pins constitute external validation (defer to B1 no-go list)
qa_items.source_of_truth: B11 §1, B19 §1, Phase 51F pins

qa_items.question: What is the state of the pilot?
qa_items.answer_snippet: We are running a controlled pilot with real human users under the B7 runbook. The pilot is internal validation with documented no-go enforcement. The pilot has not yet produced a public result.
qa_items.escalation_trigger: if audience asks for the pilot result before it is filed (defer to B19 post-pilot template; do not invent results)
qa_items.source_of_truth: B11 §1, B19 §1, B7 runbook, B18 launch checklist

qa_items.question: Is the model externally validated?
qa_items.answer_snippet: No. Finco1 has not been externally validated. External validation is a future workstream that is tracked in B16 (External Review Closeout Tracker) and is not represented as completed in this branch.
qa_items.escalation_trigger: if audience asks for an external validation result before one is provided (defer to B16 closeout tracker)
qa_items.source_of_truth: B1 no-go list, B11 §1, B16 closeout tracker

qa_items.question: Is the model in production?
qa_items.answer_snippet: No. Finco1 is not in production. The model is in internal-validation state. The B8 enterprise SaaS readiness tracker explicitly does not represent any production claim.

qa_items.source_of_truth: B1 no-go list, B8 tracker, B11 §1

qa_items.question: What is the difference between a generic solar / wind project and TUHO / Oborovo?
qa_items.answer_snippet: Generic solar and wind are exploratory and unvalidated for any external claim. TUHO and Oborovo are specific projects with outputs pinned by Phase 51F. The pinned values are regression protection, not external validation.
qa_items.escalation_trigger: if audience asks for a generic-solar / wind validation claim (defer to B2 framework)
qa_items.source_of_truth: B1 no-go list, B11 §1, B12 heatmap HC-003 / HC-004, B19 §1

qa_items.question: What is validated?
qa_items.answer_snippet: The Phase 51F pins are the only validated outputs at this time. They cover five specific metrics for TUHO and five specific metrics for Oborovo. The pins are regression protection, not external validation.
qa_items.escalation_trigger: if audience infers broader validation (defer to B3 matrix)
qa_items.source_of_truth: B3 matrix AREA-001 / AREA-002 / AREA-014, B11 §1

qa_items.question: What is internally tested?
qa_items.answer_snippet: TUHO, Oborovo, senior debt (TUHO / Oborovo scope), sponsor economics, distributions (TUHO / Oborovo scope, partial pin), Excel export, persistence / scenarios, and UI warnings are internally tested. The B3 matrix and the B12 heatmap are the source of truth for what is internally tested vs what is exploratory or pinned.

qa_items.question: What is exploratory?

global_notes: This matrix is the per-channel / per-question Q&A authority grid. The B11 commercial messaging guardrail is the project-wide rule. The B19 demo script guardrail is the demo-flow layer. The B22 demo / investor / partner Q&A guardrails add the Q&A layer.
All Q&A items are listed for every channel; the 'color' determines whether the question may be answered in the channel and under what context.
Red answers are not softened by caveats. Red answers are prohibited in any form.

The matrix does not authorize any external claim. It is internal governance. A green answer does not relax any no-go claim. A yellow answer requires the documented context. A red answer is prohibited.
Claude review is a separate workstream. The matrix records the appropriate response to questions about Claude review (QA-CLAUDE-001) but does not represent Claude review as completed.
